obligation: CPNI breach notice to law enforcement (current rule)
trigger: Reasonable determination that a person, without or exceeding authorization, intentionally gained access to, used, or disclosed CPNI (64.2011(e)); in the scenario, confirmed exfiltration of call detail records
deadline: As soon as practicable and no later than 7 business days after reasonable determination (internal target: 1 business day)
notify: USSS and FBI electronically through the FCC central reporting facility (link at fcc.gov/eb/cpni)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - telecommunications carrier and interconnected VoIP provider (64.2003(o)); no size exemption
notifying_entity: Carrier CPNI compliance officer (Carrier Senior Vice President, Regulatory and Compliance)
clock_starts: Reasonable determination of the breach (recorded in the incident log)

obligation: CPNI breach: hold on customer and public notice
trigger: Law enforcement notice filed
deadline: No customer notice or public disclosure until 7 full business days after the USSS and FBI notice, notwithstanding contrary state law. Earlier only if the carrier flags an extraordinarily urgent need and consults the investigating agency; the agency may direct a delay of up to 30 days, extendable, in writing
notify: Hold applies to every division's statements about the Carrier breach (press, website, Engineering and Tower communications)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes
notifying_entity: Carrier CPNI compliance officer (Carrier Senior Vice President, Regulatory and Compliance)
clock_starts: Filing of the law enforcement notice

obligation: CPNI breach notice to customers (current rule)
trigger: Law enforcement notice process complete
deadline: After the hold ends (or as the agency directs); the current rule sets no further outer deadline, so plan to the state-law clocks below
notify: Each customer whose CPNI was breached; enterprise and government accounts through their account representatives
applies_at_this_tier: Yes
notifying_entity: Carrier customer operations vice president with counsel

obligation: CPNI breach record
trigger: Any breach discovered
deadline: Keep at least 2 years: dates of discovery and notice, detailed description of the CPNI, circumstances
applies_at_this_tier: Yes
notifying_entity: Carrier CPNI compliance officer (Carrier Senior Vice President, Regulatory and Compliance)

obligation: CPNI and covered data breach notice (2023 amendments; NOT yet effective)
citation: 47 CFR 64.2011 as amended by FCC 23-111 (89 FR 9968); upheld in Ohio Telecom Ass'n v. FCC (6th Cir. 2025-08-13)
trigger: Would cover inadvertent as well as intentional access, and customer PII as well as CPNI
deadline: Would require FCC, USSS, and FBI notice within 7 business days; customer notice without unreasonable delay and within 30 days after reasonable determination; breaches under 500 customers with no reasonably likely harm in an annual summary
applies_at_this_tier: No - amendments to 64.2011 remain delayed indefinitely; no FCC effective-date notice in the Federal Register through 2026-10-05. Recheck at every incident
notifying_entity: Carrier CPNI compliance officer (Carrier Senior Vice President, Regulatory and Compliance)

obligation: CALEA compromise report
trigger: Any compromise of a lawful interception or of call-identifying information to unauthorized persons, or any unlawful electronic surveillance on Carrier premises; in the scenario, access to the management subnet next to SYS-C8 that cannot be ruled out
deadline: Within a reasonable time upon discovery
notify: Affected law enforcement agencies (contacts in each SSI policy appendix; through the CALEA trusted third party where used)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if SYS-C8 or intercept records are reached or cannot be ruled out
notifying_entity: Carrier Vice President, Network Security and Lawful Intercept

obligation: 911 special facility (PSAP) outage notice
trigger: Outage that potentially affects a 911 special facility, including one caused by containment (for example, isolating SBCs in an acquired region)
deadline: As soon as possible and no later than 30 minutes after discovery, by telephone and in writing electronically; first follow-up no later than 2 hours after initial contact
notify: Designated outage contacts at each affected PSAP (contacts must be confirmed annually, 4.9(h)(1); acquired-region contacts being confirmed under POAM-030)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - wireline and interconnected VoIP provider

obligation: 988 special facility outage notice
trigger: Outage that potentially affects a 988 special facility
deadline: As soon as possible and no later than 30 minutes after discovery; first follow-up no later than 2 hours after initial contact
notify: Designated contacts at the affected 988 special facility
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if 988 calls are affected

obligation: FCC outage report (wireline)
trigger: Wireline outage of at least 30 minutes that potentially affects 900,000 user minutes, 667 OC3 minutes, special offices and facilities, or a 911 or 988 special facility
deadline: Notification within 120 minutes of discovery; Initial Communications Outage Report within 72 hours; Final Communications Outage Report within 30 days
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - thresholds are outage-based, not size-based
notifying_entity: Carrier NOC director; Carrier Vice President, Network Operations approves

obligation: FCC outage report (interconnected VoIP)
trigger: VoIP outage of at least 30 minutes that potentially affects a 911 or 988 special facility, or 900,000 user minutes with complete loss of service, or special offices and facilities
deadline: Notification within 240 minutes (911 or 988 facility affected) or 24 hours (other triggers); Final Communications Outage Report within 30 days
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - about 1.1 million interconnected VoIP lines

obligation: DIRS daily reporting
trigger: FCC activates DIRS for an area served (for example, a hurricane during the incident)
deadline: Daily infrastructure status reports from activation until deactivation; timely DIRS reports substitute for NORS in that area
applies_at_this_tier: Yes when activated

obligation: Annual CPNI certification follow-up
trigger: Any breach or customer complaints about unauthorized release of CPNI during the year
deadline: Filed on or before March 1 for the prior calendar year; the statement must accurately describe operating procedures and include a summary of complaints
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - each of the 10 Carrier filers
notifying_entity: Carrier CPNI compliance officer (Carrier Senior Vice President, Regulatory and Compliance)

obligation: SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05 (material cybersecurity incident)
trigger: The disclosure committee determines the incident is material to the group
deadline: Within 4 business days after the materiality determination; materiality decided without unreasonable delay after discovery. Delay otherwise only on a U.S. Attorney General determination (1.05(c))
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - the holding company is an SEC registrant

obligation: SEC Form 8-K delay for a CPNI breach
trigger: Registrant subject to 47 CFR 64.2011 must delay disclosing a CPNI breach under 64.2011(b)(1)
deadline: Filing may be delayed for the period that applies under 64.2011(b)(1), and in no event more than 7 business days after the law enforcement notice, if the registrant sends correspondence on EDGAR no later than the date the Item 1.05 filing was otherwise due. The exception does not cover agency-directed delays under 64.2011(b)(3)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - the Carrier is subject to 64.2011; counsel confirms at each incident that the delay is available to the holding company

obligation: SEC Reg S-K Item 106 annual disclosure
trigger: Annual report
deadline: Next Form 10-K describes risk management, strategy, and governance; consider describing material effects of the incident
applies_at_this_tier: Yes

obligation: Florida breach notice to individuals (worked example)
trigger: Breach of security of personal information of Florida residents. In the scenario, a legacy billing export with names and SSNs used for credit checks (about 21,000 Floridians). CDRs with names and numbers alone may not meet Florida's definition; counsel decides
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach or reason to believe one occurred (the 15-day extension for good cause applies only to this notice). Notice under the primary or functional federal regulator's rules is deemed compliant if a copy is timely provided to the Department of Legal Affairs; counsel decides whether FCC CPNI notice qualifies. A law enforcement agency's written request can delay notice (501.171(4)(b))
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if Florida-defined personal information is involved
notifying_entity: Carrier CPNI compliance officer with counsel

obligation: Florida notice to the Department of Legal Affairs
trigger: Breach affecting 500 or more individuals in Florida
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach (no extension)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if 500 or more Floridians' personal information

obligation: Florida notice to consumer reporting agencies
trigger: Notice to more than 1,000 individuals at one time
deadline: Without unreasonable delay
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if more than 1,000
clock_starts: Decision to notify more than 1,000 individuals

obligation: State data breach notification (other states)
citation: State breach notification statutes (all 50 states, DC, PR, USVI; Guam 9 GCA Ch. 48)
trigger: Breach of computerized personal information of residents of other states (the second acquired region; customers who live elsewhere)
deadline: Varies by state (for example 'without unreasonable delay' or a fixed number of days)
notify: Affected residents; state attorney general or regulator where the state requires it; consumer reporting agencies above state-set counts
applies_at_this_tier: Always check. Apply the law of each state where affected individuals reside

obligation: Engineering MNO customer security incident notice
trigger: Security incident affecting a customer's network or data (in the scenario, 3 customers' networks reached through SYS-E1)
deadline: Within 24 hours (41 contracts) or 72 hours (23 contracts) of discovery; describe the incident affecting the customer without disclosing the Carrier's CPNI breach during the 64.2011 hold
notify: Customer security contacts; carrier customers then run their own CPNI clocks
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual

obligation: Engineering MNO customer outage notice
trigger: Detected outage in a customer network that may be reportable (including one caused by containment of SYS-E1)
deadline: Within 30 minutes of detection, so carrier customers can meet their 911 and NORS clocks
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual

obligation: Third-party agent notice to customers (worked example)
trigger: Engineering, as a third-party agent, holds personal information for a customer that is a covered entity (subscriber names and addresses in MNO tickets) and a breach occurs
deadline: Notify the covered entity within 10 days following determination of the breach or reason to believe one occurred
notify: Each affected customer; other states' third-party duties per statute
applies_at_this_tier: Yes for 2 carrier customers in the scenario
notifying_entity: Engineering MNO general manager with counsel

obligation: Covered telecommunications equipment discovered
citation: FAR 52.204-25(d) (Section 889); FAR 52.240-91(h) in awards under an agency's FAR Part 40 class deviation
trigger: Engineering or the Carrier identifies covered telecommunications equipment or services in a federal contract during forensics or rebuild
deadline: Within 1 business day of identification; further information within 10 business days. Under FAR 52.240-91(h) (new awards under an agency's FAR Part 40 class deviation): one report within 72 hours, to https://dibnet.dod.mil for DoD or to the contracting officer for other agencies; a further report within 72 hours of finding missing information.
notify: Contracting officer for each affected contract
applies_at_this_tier: Yes for the Engineering and Carrier federal contracts if found (not found in the scenario)

obligation: Kaspersky covered article discovered
citation: FAR 52.204-23(c); FAR 52.240-91(h) in awards under an agency's FAR Part 40 class deviation
trigger: A Kaspersky covered article provided to the Government is identified during performance
deadline: Within 3 business days of identification; further information within 10 business days. Under FAR 52.240-91(h) (new awards under an agency's FAR Part 40 class deviation): one report within 72 hours, to https://dibnet.dod.mil for DoD or to the contracting officer for other agencies; a further report within 72 hours of finding missing information.
applies_at_this_tier: Yes for federal contracts if found (not found in the scenario)

obligation: Federal contract incident terms (FCI)
citation: FAR 52.204-21 and each contract's own terms
trigger: Incident affecting the SYS-E2 FCI enclave
deadline: 52.204-21 itself sets no incident reporting deadline; check each of the 12 contracts for agency-specific terms
notify: Contracting officers as each contract requires
applies_at_this_tier: Check - the enclave was not reached in the scenario

obligation: FAA report of obstruction light outage
trigger: A top steady burning or flashing obstruction light outage not corrected within 30 minutes, including outages discovered late because monitoring was lost during containment
deadline: Immediately, by means acceptable to the FAA; extend the outage if not repaired within the NOTAM period; notify immediately when normal operation resumes
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - about 6,200 registered structures with lighting specifications
notifying_entity: Tower site operations director (Alarm Monitoring Center)
clock_starts: 30 minutes after the outage is observed or otherwise known

obligation: Lighting observation when the alarm system is down
trigger: The automatic alarm system cannot indicate failures (for example, the alarm tenant is isolated)
deadline: Observe each affected structure's lights at least once each 24 hours, visually or by a properly maintained indicator, until monitoring is restored
notify: Internal (field crews); not a notice, but the clock that drives the fallback
applies_at_this_tier: Yes

obligation: Antenna structure light outage record
trigger: Any observed or known light outage
deadline: Record nature, date and time observed, FAA notice time, and repairs; keep 2 years; provide to the FCC on request
applies_at_this_tier: Yes

obligation: Tower tenant notice
citation: Tenant lease terms (site access and security clauses)
trigger: Incident affecting tenant equipment or site access (for example, compromised smart lock credentials)
deadline: Per lease
applies_at_this_tier: Check - not triggered unless SYS-T2 locks or tenant equipment are affected

obligation: Carrier enterprise and government customer contract notice
citation: Customer contracts (2,300 dedicated-representative accounts; federal transport contracts)
trigger: Security incident affecting the customer's CPNI or services
deadline: Per contract; customer notice of a CPNI breach still waits for the 64.2011(b) hold unless the investigating agency agrees
notify: Dedicated account representatives notify contract contacts
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual

obligation: Voluntary report to FBI and CISA
trigger: Suspected nation-state intrusion
deadline: Day 0 to Day 1; supports OFAC mitigation if any payment is considered
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - voluntary

obligation: CIRCIA covered cyber incident and ransom payment reports (pending final rule)
trigger: Covered cyber incident or ransom payment
deadline: Statute: 72 hours (covered incident); 24 hours (ransom payment). Not yet effective
applies_at_this_tier: No - no final rule published as of 2026-10-05
clock_starts: Would be reasonable belief of a covered incident

obligation: OFAC sanctions check before any ransom or extortion payment
citation: OFAC Updated Advisory on Potential Sanctions Risks for Facilitating Ransomware Payments (Sept. 21, 2021); 31 CFR ch. V
trigger: Considering a ransom or extortion payment
deadline: Before any payment; full and timely reporting to law enforcement or CISA is a mitigating factor
notify: OFAC (license if a sanctioned party); FBI or CISA
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - all U.S. persons; strict liability for payments to sanctioned parties
notifying_entity: Group General Counsel; board risk committee approves

obligation: Cyber insurance claim notice
trigger: Suspected security incident
deadline: Per policy (use the insurer's breach hotline before hiring vendors)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual
